purpose: Integrity Black series — Bao Zheng themed enamel pin and metal bookmark
prompt:
Product variant photograph for 脸谱潮 LIANPU CHAO — "刚直黑 Integrity Black" series featuring Bao Zheng theme.

Scene: Two products on a rice-paper #f5f0e8 textured surface:
1. A round enamel pin (35mm) — gold #d4a843 metal border, ink-black #1a1a2e as dominant fill. The pin shows a deconstructed Bao Zheng opera mask: the iconic crescent moon (月牙) on the forehead is the central motif, rendered in gold #d4a843 against the black face. Symmetrical bold pattern with thick outlines. Small cinnabar-red #e8433f accent on the mouth area.
2. A brass/gold metal bookmark — laser-etched with the same Bao Zheng mask pattern. The metal has a warm gold-leaf #d4a843 tone with fine detail lines showing the crescent moon and symmetrical face patterns.

Black dominates the visual area. Gold provides luxury and gravitas — reflecting Bao Zheng's "iron face impartial" character. The crescent moon is clearly visible as the key identifier.

Style: Guochao illustration — bold flat colors, thick outlines, no gradients. Product photography quality with real material textures (enamel gloss, metallic luster). Clean lighting on rice-paper background creates elegant contrast. Premium, dignified feel.
